nodes.label: Core Holds No Model Client
nodes.rationale: Intelligence lives in the executor package reasoning through the host CLI or an operator-owned endpoint, so hosts capture, trigger, inject and recall without holding a key; an empty reply never advances a watermark.

nodes.label: Fixed-Grammar Manage Verdicts
nodes.rationale: The reasoner chooses only from the menu the core drafted and replies in a fixed grammar, so a hijacked judgment can only fail to decide, never invent an operation.

hyperedges.label: Host-Borrowed Reasoning Without a Core Model Client
